prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. One strong central scene occupies about two thirds. All supplied teaching text MUST be rendered INSIDE the image. Preserve Swedish å, ä, ö and every letter exactly. Generous margins, phone-legible text. No watermark, logo, app chrome, contact sheet, or unsupplied paragraphs. Sound/spelling associations are memory aids, never pronunciation or etymological claims.
Header text verbatim: "kunglig". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "royal".
Scene: An elegant palace with a crown emblem over the main entrance and formal gardens, no real coats of arms or readable signage.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "kunglig = royal; connected with a king or queen.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Det är ett kungligt slott.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
